svg.title: Приседания с гирей гоблет — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Goblet squat with one kettlebell held close against the sternum, both hands on its handle horns, bell below handle. Left: stand tall, both feet a little wider than shoulders, stable on floor. Right: same stance and bell at chest, hips lowered in squat with knees bent and tracking toward toes, heels remain down. Three-quarter front view. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
